purpose: Evaluate leakage-safe early-lifecycle ranking methods after calibrating their ranking scores onto a return scale using only strictly prior historical outcomes.
point_forecast_calibration_contract: Within each target cutoff, convert the raw ranking score to a percentile and map that percentile onto the realized-return distribution from strictly earlier cutoffs only.
prior_information_rule: Only cases with decision_cutoff strictly before the target cutoff may contribute realized outcomes to a prior or return calibration.

selection_policy.primary: positive rank correlation and positive top-bottom spread on calibrated return forecasts
selection_policy.secondary: maximize 70-percent breakout recall and top-quantile capture while minimizing false-negative and false-positive rates
selection_policy.guardrail: no candidate may be promoted from this tournament without owner review, broader lifecycle evidence, and negative-case coverage
